description: FK → Calendar Date Dimension. Date key: Issued Date (join qua Penalty Decision)
etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = penalty_decision.issued_dt AND penalty_decision.issued_dt = :etl_date

description: FK → Penalty Decision Subject Dimension (nullable — QĐ chưa có đối tượng vẫn có 1 dòng, BA 2026-10-01 LEFT JOIN PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT)
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN penalty_decision_subject ON penalty_decision_subject.pd_id = penalty_decision.pd_id AND penalty_decision_subject.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT' → LOOKUP penalty_decision_subject_dim ON penalty_decision_subject_dim.penalty_decision_subject_code = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_code
